summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Bretton J. Key CMS site. Backend is fully functional (43/43 tests passed). Frontend loads correctly with all rooms rendering, navigation scrolling working (recent bug fix verified), and admin CMS accessible. Found one critical bug: Dialog/Sheet/Lightbox close buttons not working, blocking user interactions after opening modals.

critical_bugs.issue: Close buttons (X) on Service Sheets and Gallery Lightbox do not close the modal. The overlay remains open with data-state='open', blocking all page interactions including form submissions and navigation.
reproduction_steps: 2. Click any service title to open the Service Sheet
3. Click the X close button in top-right corner
4. Observe: Sheet does not close, overlay remains blocking page
2. Click any gallery image to open lightbox
4. Observe: Lightbox does not close, overlay remains blocking page
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot close modals once opened, making the site unusable after first modal interaction. Cannot submit contact form, navigate to projects, or interact with any other page elements.
critical_bugs.suggested_fix: Check Dialog/Sheet close button onClick handlers. Verify that the close button is properly wired to the Dialog/Sheet state management. May need to add explicit onOpenChange handlers or ensure the DialogClose trigger is properly configured.

items.description: The close (X) buttons on Service Sheets and Gallery Lightbox do not close the modals. The overlay remains open with data-state='open', blocking all subsequent page interactions. This makes the site unusable after opening any modal.
suggested_investigation: 1. Check if DialogClose/SheetClose components are properly imported and used
2. Verify onClick handlers on close buttons are wired to state management
3. Check if onOpenChange prop is properly passed to Dialog/Sheet components
4. Test if Escape key closes the modals (may indicate close button specific issue)
5. Verify shadcn/ui Dialog and Sheet components are correctly configured
